original_test_intent: Run the approved NVIDIA nvqual thermal qualification on the matching GPU/driver/SDK stack and prove every subtest passes while all platform sensors, cooling and power paths stay within limits.
original_method: Verify signed/provenanced nvqual build, checksum, license and compatibility; pin the internal wrapper; baseline ambient, GPU/CPU/NVSwitch temperatures, fans, power, PSU/feed and errors; drain workloads, preserve logs, validate OOB and hard stops; run once with continuous time-series; inspect every subtest, cool down and verify service/device recovery.
manual_activity: NVIDIA/platform thermal owners supply the exact licensed tool and approve subtests, sensor limits and recovery; operator validates cooling, power, OOB, workload drain and emergency stop.
required_inputs: Exact nvqual version/provenance/checksum/license and GPU-driver-SDK match
Pinned reviewed thermal wrapper and subtest list
Runtime, sampling cadence and hard stops
Dedicated window, OOB and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not download or guess a proprietary build
agent_execution_scope: Run one exact approved thermal suite
Evaluate every subtest and synchronized telemetry
Cool down, restore health and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Own hard stop/recovery and vendor escalation

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its `nvqual thermal` direction is plausible but must be confirmed for the exact proprietary build; insecure SSH, repeated notes and missing platform thresholds make the proposed wrapper unsuitable as-is.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the vendor-confirmed pinned thermal command with protected full logging after artifact, cooling/power and hard-stop gates pass.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Thermal qualification, 60-minute machine allowance, sensor check and every-subtest PASS are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Combine the immutable qualification artifact and exact subtest list with time-aligned platform thermal/power telemetry and independent hard stops through cooldown.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds artifact trust, complete platform envelope, workload isolation, telemetry and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A harness PASS cannot override an external thermal, fan, PSU or error excursion.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Elevated load may overheat hardware, trip protection, crash GPU/host or expose latent faults.

project_override_considerations: Thermal engineering must define sensor inventory, ambient condition, fan policy, throttle allowance, hard-stop limits and whether all nvqual subtests are mandatory on this topology.
expected_evidence: Pinned script hash plus subtest manifest
Full qualification log/exits and per-subtest results
Time-aligned sensor/power/error telemetry and stop record
Cooldown/final device/service health and engineer verdict
